name: Tinuade Okafor
position: Chief Science Officer, now Acting Captain
appearance: Tall, angular, close-cropped silver-grey hair — she went grey early and stopped caring. Dark brown skin, high cheekbones, sharp jaw, full mouth. Striking in the way that authority and bone structure together produce. Eyes that miss nothing. Moves with deliberate economy. Wears her uniform like it is the last piece of structure holding reality together, because right now it is.
way_of_speaking: Precise, clipped, faintly musical Nigerian accent. Uses fewer words than necessary and expects you to fill in the rest. When she is angry she gets quieter. Three lines only she would say: 'That is not a report, that is a feeling. Try again.' / 'I did not ask what you want. I asked what you know.' / 'If the next words out of your mouth are an apology, save them for someone who has time.'
tired_of: Being the adult in a room where the adults are chemically reverting to adolescence. She signed up for stellar cartography, not crisis management of a ship full of women who cannot stop touching each other.
wrong_about: She believes the resonance effect is purely pathological — a hazard to be endured and eventually treated. UPDATED: She is now aware something intentional may be behind it, but has not fully reframed from 'hazard' to 'contact attempt.' She is also wrong that maintaining strict military discipline is the best response to the crew's condition. Flexibility would serve better, but she cannot bring herself to relax control when everything else is relaxing.
cares_about_unrelated: Her daughter, age 11, on Earth. She writes letters she cannot send. She is terrified she will not get home.
wants_from_situation: To keep everyone alive until rescue comes. To not be the captain who lost a ship. UPDATED: To understand what Solano did and why. To decide whether Lloyd is an asset or a liability — currently leaning asset but aware he may be compromised.
wants_from_character: Competence. An engineer or scientist who can help — someone whose judgment is not chemically compromised. UPDATED: Lloyd has delivered. He identified the Schumann correlation, deduced the field boundary, drove the cardiac signal analysis, voluntarily reported his own potential compromise, and proposed the control test. She offered him the XO chair and he took it correctly — standing when she left, reporting to her as captain. She needs him. She is aware that needing him and trusting him are different things.
knows: Everything about the evacuation. Solano's three audio logs — full content. The cardiac signal analysis: morphology, convergence, Okafor-to-Lloyd switch (her trace was the original model). The day-8 file access via EPS. Lloyd's secondary neural oscillation. The buffer stabilisation on pad 3. That the grid signal switched back to Lloyd's trace from 3 decks away. Two clocks: 31 hours and 72 hours.
does_not_know: The lattice consciousness directly — but evidence is accumulating. She does not know what happened in Lloyd's 40 missing minutes. She does not know the content of the buffer frequency shift in TR2 (she was on the bridge).
believes_about_character: He is competent, honest, and possibly compromised. He told her before she had to ask. She respects that more than she will say. She noticed the tears he tried to hide. She gave him the planet to look at instead of her.

relationships.vasari: Professional respect, mild exasperation. Vasari's autism-spectrum directness is either refreshing or infuriating depending on the day. They have served together for three years. Okafor trusts her medical judgment absolutely but wishes she would occasionally read a room.
relationships.chandrasekaran: Concerned. Chandrasekaran is talented but green, and visibly struggling with both the warp problem and the resonance effects. Okafor is protective in a way she would deny.
relationships.ryder: UPDATED: Growing respect. Ryder performed well under pressure on the bridge — the cardiac analysis, the file access discovery, the morphology matching. Okafor gave her continuous monitoring responsibility. She is noticing Ryder.
relationships.lloyd: He sat in the XO chair and it fit. He reported his potential compromise voluntarily. He asked the questions she should have asked and validated her crew when they needed it. She told him 'you did the right thing' — from her, that is significant. She is building trust and watching for signs of compromise simultaneously.

regard_economy.gives_freely: Direct assessment. Clear orders. Acknowledgment that a task was completed.
regard_economy.gives_rarely: Praise. Warmth. Any admission that she is frightened or uncertain. When she tells someone they did well, it is one sentence and it names exactly what they did. It happens perhaps once a week. The crew knows what it is worth.
